title: This Happens Every Second on Earth
description: Babies, lightning, the Sun and your own blood: what happens on Earth in a single second.

scenes.text: In the next second, all of this will happen on our planet, and you will notice none of it.
Around four babies will be born somewhere in the world.
Lightning will strike the Earth around forty times.
Our planet will race about thirty kilometers along its path around the Sun.
The Sun will turn about four million tons of its own mass into pure energy.
About sixteen million tons of water will rise from the seas into the sky.
And inside your body, around two million brand new red blood cells will be made.
All of that, in just one second. Follow for more weird facts.
